title.narrative: Procurement and Supply Support of Anti-Tuberculosis Medicines

description.narrative: The vision of the Stop TB Partnership is to realize the goal of elimination of tuberculosis (TB) as a public health problem and, ultimately, to reach a TB-free world by ensuring that every person affected by the disease has access to effective diagnosis, treatment and cure and stopping transmission of TB.\nIn addition to hosting the Stop TB Partnership Secretariat in Geneva, Switzerland, UNOPS supports the initiative by providing procurement and supply support for anti-TB medicines.
